question.text: A series LCR circuit is connected to an ac source of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>220</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>50</mn><mo> </mo><mi>Hz</mi></math>. The circuit contain a resistance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>100</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math> and an inductor of inductive reactance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>X</mi><mi>L</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>79</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>6</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math>. The capacitance of the capacitor needed to maximize the average rate at which energy is supplied will be ______ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>μF</mi></math>.

solution.text:
The average rate at which energy supplied i.e. power delivered is maximum in case of the resonance, therefore

XC=XL

⇒1ωC=79.6 Ω

⇒   C=1ω×79.6=12πf×79.6=1100π×79.6=40  μF

Hence, C=40 μF.
